ayahs.textEnglish: SO THAT the Quraysh might remain secure,
secure in their winter and summer journeys,
Let them, therefore, worship the Sustainer of this Temple;

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْٓ اَطْعَمَهُمْ مِّنْ جُوْعٍ ەۙ وَّاٰمَنَهُمْ مِّنْ خَوْفٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażī aṭ‘amahum min jū‘(in), wa āmanahum min khauf(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: who has given them food against hunger, and made them safe from danger.
